title.zh: 貝氏知識論與預測編碼：消滅教條與動態戰略決策 (CEO/策略長 視角)
title.en: Bayesian Epistemology & Predictive Processing: Destroying Dogma & Dynamic Decision-Making (CEO/CSO)

slide_title.zh: 教條主義的死局與貝氏覺醒 (SCQA & The Bayesian Mandate)
slide_title.en: The Death of Dogma & The Bayesian Mandate (SCQA)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：面對高度變動的市場與新科技 (如 GenAI)，高管團隊依然固守過去十年的成功經驗與傳統商業直覺，將其視為不可挑戰的「真理」
衝突 (Complication)：這種非黑即白的「教條主義」導致了嚴重的確認偏誤 (Confirmation Bias)。當市場數據（證據）與高管直覺衝突時，組織傾向於否認現實，導致戰略撞牆
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：提議徹底揚棄絕對真理觀。懇請授權導入「貝氏知識論 (Bayesian Epistemology)」，將企業的決策系統升級為「基於機率不斷迭代更新」的預測機器
en: Situation: Facing hyper-volatile markets and exponential tech (e.g., GenAI), the C-Suite fiercely clings to the success formulas of the past decade, treating them as unchallengeable 'truths.'

Complication: This binary 'Dogmatism' triggers severe Confirmation Bias. When real-time market telemetry (evidence) contradicts executive intuition, the organization denies reality, steering blindly into catastrophic failure.

The Ask: Proposing the total destruction of absolute truths in our boardroom. Requesting the mandate to deploy 'Bayesian Epistemology,' upgrading our decision architecture into a probabilistic, continuously updating prediction machine.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事，在 AI 與劇變的時代，固守『過去的成功經驗』是致命的。我們常在會議室裡爭論誰對誰錯，這是傳統的二元思維。但在真實世界裡，沒有絕對的真理。今天的提案，是要將最高決策層的思維升級為『貝氏推論』。我們不再說『這份戰略絕對正確』，而是說『基於目前情報，它有 70% 的勝率；明天拿到新數據後，我們立刻更新機率』。我們必須消滅教條，建立動態迭代的智慧。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, in an era of AI and exponential disruption, clinging to 'past success formulas' is a death sentence. We argue in boardrooms over who is 'right' and 'wrong'—a fatal binary mindset. In reality, absolute truths do not exist. Today's mandate elevates the C-Suite to 'Bayesian Inference.' We stop declaring, 'This strategy is flawless.' Instead, we state, 'Given current telemetry, this has a 70% probability of success; as new evidence arrives tomorrow, we update the math.' We must annihilate dogma and institutionalize dynamic, probabilistic agility.

slide_title.zh: 貝氏更新：先驗與後驗的動態融合 (Bayesian Updating: Priors & Posteriors)
slide_title.en: Bayesian Updating: The Math of Dynamic Truth

zh: 先驗機率 (The Prior)：所有的戰略與商業直覺都只是一個「先驗信念 (Prior)」。它不是真理，而是我們下場博弈的「起始猜測值」
證據的衝擊 (The Likelihood / Evidence)：當新技術或競爭對手出現時，我們不是尋找證據來「證明」自己對，而是用新證據來「修正」原有的猜測
後驗機率 (The Posterior)：強勢意見，弱勢堅持 (Strong Opinions, Weakly Held)。結合先驗與新證據，產出更新後的「後驗機率」。昨日的後驗，就是今日的先驗，形成永不停止的進化迴圈
en: The Prior: Every corporate strategy and executive intuition is merely a 'Prior Belief.' It is never absolute truth; it is simply our 'starting baseline guess' for entering the battlefield.
The Evidence (Likelihood): When market shocks or competitor maneuvers occur, we do not cherry-pick data to 'prove' our initial guess. We use cold evidence to ruthlessly 'update' our baseline.

The Posterior: 'Strong Opinions, Weakly Held.' Merging the Prior with new Evidence generates the updated 'Posterior Probability.' Yesterday's Posterior becomes today's Prior, engineering a perpetual loop of evolutionary learning.

speaker_notes.zh: 貝氏定理告訴我們：學習就是『用新證據來更新舊觀念』的過程。你的商業直覺就是『先驗 (Prior)』，這沒問題。但當市場給你一記耳光（新證據）時，你必須立刻算出『後驗機率 (Posterior)』。很多公司倒閉，是因為 CEO 把先驗當成了宗教信仰，拒絕用新數據更新大腦。卓越的組織文化是『強勢意見，弱勢堅持』——我對我的戰略有極強的信心，但只要你拿出新數據，我一秒鐘就可以改變我的立場。
speaker_notes.en: Bayes' Theorem defines learning as the mathematical process of 'updating old beliefs with new evidence.' Your executive intuition is your 'Prior.' That is fine. But when the market punches you in the face (New Evidence), you must instantly calculate the 'Posterior.' Companies die because CEOs treat their Priors as religious dogma, refusing to update their mental models. Elite culture demands 'Strong Opinions, Weakly Held'—I am profoundly confident in my strategy, but the millisecond you present valid counter-evidence, I update my stance.

slide_title.zh: 預測編碼與自由能原理 (Predictive Processing & Free Energy)
slide_title.en: Predictive Processing & The Free Energy Principle

zh: 預測機器 (The Prediction Machine)：神經科學大師 Karl Friston 提出，大腦（與企業）本質上是一台預測機器，其唯一目標是最小化「預測誤差（驚喜/Surprise，即自由能）」
兩種生存路徑 (Two Paths to Survival)：當現實與戰略不符（產生驚喜）時，企業只有兩條路：一是「更新內部模型（學習與變革）」，二是「改變外部環境（主動出擊/洗腦自己）」
組織精神分裂 (Corporate Schizophrenia)：當企業拒絕更新內部戰略，又無力改變市場時，就會陷入「認知失調與造假」。高管會開始竄改財報與 KPI，以維持虛假的預測精準度
en: The Prediction Machine: Neuroscientist Karl Friston posits that the brain (and the Enterprise) is a prediction engine whose sole biological mandate is to minimize 'Prediction Error' (Surprise / Free Energy).

Two Paths to Survival: When reality contradicts the strategic plan (generating 'Surprise'), the enterprise has two options: Update the internal model (Learning/Pivoting) or alter the external environment (Active Action/Denial).

Corporate Schizophrenia: When an enterprise refuses to update its strategy and lacks the power to change the market, it descends into 'Cognitive Dissonance.' Executives manipulate KPIs and financial reports to create a hallucination of accuracy.

speaker_notes.zh: 神經科學界最頂尖的『自由能原理』告訴我們：大腦最討厭『驚喜 (預測誤差)』。企業也是一樣。當季報不如預期，這就是一個巨大的驚喜。這時我們有兩個選擇：第一，承認我們的戰略（預測模型）錯了，立刻更新它；第二，去改變市場。最可怕的是第三種：高管為了假裝自己沒錯，開始竄改數據、隱瞞壞消息。這在醫學上叫精神分裂，在商業上叫安隆案 (Enron)。我們必須建立一個容許『更新模型』的心理安全環境。
speaker_notes.en: Neuroscience's 'Free Energy Principle' proves the brain despises 'Surprise' (prediction error). The enterprise is identical. When quarterly earnings miss projections, that is a massive 'Surprise.' We have two choices: acknowledge our strategic model was wrong and update it, or actively change the market. The fatal third option occurs when executives, desperate to pretend their model is flawless, begin manipulating data and hiding risk to artificially erase the 'surprise.' Medically, this is psychosis; corporately, this is Enron. We must build a psychologically safe culture that rewards 'updating the model.'

slide_title.zh: 貝氏調解與 AI 幻覺對齊 (Bayesian Mediation & AI Alignment)

zh: 貝氏調解 (Bayesian Mediation)：衝突的本質是勞資雙方擁有截然不同的「先驗信念」。高階調解員不爭論對錯，而是提供「高權重的新證據」，溫和且在數學上強制雙方「更新後驗機率」，達致共識
AI 幻覺的知識論解析 (Epistemology of AI Hallucinations)：LLM (大型語言模型) 本身就是貝氏推論機器。當 AI 產生「幻覺 (Hallucination)」時，是因為它的「先驗權重」過度壓制了提示詞 (Prompt) 帶來的「證據」
人機協同的雙向對齊 (Bidirectional Alignment)：AI 治理不只是約束機器，更要求高管更新自身的「認知先驗」。面對 ISO 42001，人類與 AI 必須透過不斷交換證據，達成雙向的機率收斂
en: Bayesian Mediation: The root of conflict is two parties holding drastically opposed 'Prior Beliefs.' An elite Mediator doesn't argue morality; they inject 'high-weight new evidence' to gently but mathematically force both sides to 'update their Posteriors' toward a shared reality.

Epistemology of AI Hallucinations: LLMs are literal Bayesian engines. 'Hallucinations' occur when the AI's internal 'Prior' is so heavily weighted that it overrules and ignores the actual 'Evidence' provided in the user's prompt.

Bidirectional Alignment: AI Governance (ISO 42001) isn't just about restricting algorithms; it requires executives to update their own cognitive Priors. True alignment is achieved when humans and AI exchange evidence to mathematically converge on reality.

speaker_notes.zh: 這套理論完美解釋了『調解』與『AI』。在勞資糾紛中，雙方都有極端固執的『先驗』。我作為調解員，絕不說誰錯。我只負責把『新證據（例如訴訟成本的試算）』放到桌上，強迫他們的大腦進行貝氏更新，最後他們自己會算出妥協才是最佳解。同樣的，LLM 為什麼會產生幻覺？因為它太固執於自己訓練資料裡的『先驗』，忽略了你輸入的提示詞。懂了貝氏，你就同時懂了如何調解人性，以及如何治理 AI。
speaker_notes.en: This framework flawlessly unites 'Mediation' and 'AI Governance.' In labor disputes, both sides possess fiercely rigid 'Priors.' As a Mediator, I never declare anyone 'wrong.' I simply inject irrefutable 'new evidence' (e.g., the exact financial math of litigation costs). Their brains are biologically forced to execute a Bayesian update, organically converging on a compromise. Similarly, why do LLMs hallucinate? Because their training-data 'Priors' are so heavily weighted they hallucinate over your prompt's 'Evidence.' Mastering Bayes allows you to govern both human conflict and Generative AI.

slide_title.zh: 100 天決策引擎與貝氏升級藍圖 (100-Day Bayesian Reboot)

zh: 第 1-30 天 (消滅教條與機率化預測)：全面廢除「絕對承諾制」的目標設定，改採「機率分佈預測 (Probabilistic Forecasting)」，允許前線主管以「勝率 (如 75%)」來回報專案進度
第 31-100 天 (貝氏調解與紅軍反饋)：將「貝氏證據更新」技術納入中高階主管的談判與調解培訓，並在重大決策前強制引入「紅軍 (Red Team)」提供反面證據，避免先驗固化
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請董事會認知「固執不是領導力，動態更新才是」。授權將企業的決策架構從「靜態的法典」升級為「動態自我學習的貝氏神經網絡」
en: Days 1-30 (Destroying Dogma & Probabilistic Forecasting): Abolishing the culture of 'absolute certainty promises.' Deploying 'Probabilistic Forecasting,' permitting frontline leaders to report project trajectories in 'confidence percentages' (e.g., 75% success probability).

Days 31-100 (Bayesian Mediation & Red Teaming): Integrating 'Bayesian Evidence Updating' into C-Suite mediation training. Mandating 'Red Team' counter-evidence injections before all major decisions to prevent Prior ossification.

Call to Action: Requesting the Board acknowledge that 'stubbornness is not leadership; dynamic updating is.' Mandating the upgrade of our decision architecture from a 'static legal code' into a 'dynamically learning Bayesian neural network.'

speaker_notes.zh: 這是未來 100 天的企業大腦升級藍圖。第一個月，我們要消滅『拍胸脯保證』的文化。以後匯報，不要告訴我『一定會成』，告訴我『根據目前證據，有 80% 的機率會成』。接下來的兩個月，我們要教導所有主管學會『貝氏調解』，並且在做重大決策前，強制讓紅軍（反方）提出反面證據，強迫我們更新觀念。懇請董事會授權，讓我們放棄愚蠢的教條，把這家公司變成一台極致聰明、永遠在學習的預測機器。
speaker_notes.en: This is the 100-day upgrade blueprint for our corporate brain. In Month 1, we annihilate the culture of 'absolute guarantees.' Moving forward, do not report 'it is guaranteed to succeed.' Report 'based on current evidence, probability of success is 80%.' Over Months 2 and 3, we train all executives in 'Bayesian Mediation' and mandate Red Team counter-evidence injections to force continuous mental updating before critical decisions. I ask the Board to mandate this evolution, transforming this enterprise from a dogmatic bureaucracy into an infinitely learning, ruthlessly accurate prediction machine.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『貝氏知識論與預測編碼』簡報。受眾為董事會、CEO 或策略長。內容必須將機率數學與神經科學降維應用於企業決策與調解實戰：1. 運用 SCQA 點出『教條主義』與『確認偏誤』如何導致企業戰略撞牆，2. 導入『貝氏定理 (先驗與後驗)』，主張將戰略視為必須根據新證據不斷迭代的機率分佈，3. 運用 Friston 的『自由能原理 (預測編碼)』說明組織為何會陷入竄改財報的『認知失調』，4. 將貝氏框架應用於『高階調解 (Mediation)』與『AI 幻覺治理』，指出衝突與幻覺皆源自『先驗權重過高』，5. 結尾給出 100 天貝氏升級藍圖，要求以機率化預測取代絕對承諾。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具數學理性的冷酷、哲學的通透，以及直指大腦底層運作機制的權威感。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Bayesian Epistemology & Predictive Processing' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors, CEO, or Chief Strategy Officer. Demonstrate the elite application of probability mathematics and neuroscience to corporate decision-making and mediation: 1. Use SCQA to frame how 'Dogmatism' and 'Confirmation Bias' drive strategic suicide. 2. Introduce 'Bayesian Updating (Priors & Posteriors),' demanding strategies be treated as probabilistic models updated continuously by new evidence. 3. Deploy Friston's 'Free Energy Principle' to explain why organizations descend into cognitive dissonance and financial fraud to avoid 'prediction errors.' 4. Apply the Bayesian framework to 'Advanced Mediation' and 'AI Hallucination Governance,' diagnosing both human conflict and AI errors as 'over-weighted Priors.' 5. Conclude with a 100-Day Bayesian Reboot Blueprint, demanding the replacement of absolute targets with probabilistic forecasting. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must project mathematical clinicality, philosophical clarity, and absolute authority over the fundamental mechanics of the mind and algorithms.
